goal_prompt: Read numbers.txt where each line is an integer. Write to running_total.txt the running (cumulative) sum after each line, one integer per line in order.
structural_difference: RUNNING_TOTAL: computes prefix sums (cumulative). No train task produces a running sum — train only produces final aggregates. 30, 35, 50 not in seed (10,20,5,15).
notes: Seed: 10, 10+20=30, 30+5=35, 35+15=50. Running values not in seed. Echo-immune (none of 30,35,50 appear in seed).

goal_prompt: Read entries.txt which has lines of text. Write to upper.txt the same lines but with every character converted to uppercase.

files.entries.txt:
river delta
mountain pass
coastal plain

structural_difference: CASE_TRANSFORM: character-level map operation. Train tasks do not include case transformation. Easy difficulty.
notes: Seed: 3 geography phrases. Uppercased form not in prompt.

goal_prompt: Read pairs.txt where each line is 'left right'. Write to swapped.txt lines in the form 'right left' (swap the two tokens on each line).

files.pairs.txt:
sun moon
fire water
earth sky

structural_difference: TOKEN_SWAP: reverses token order within each line. Train t007 inverts key=value; this swaps space-delimited tokens. Different syntax and operation.
notes: Seed: 3 word pairs. Swapped form not in prompt.

goal_prompt: Read nums.txt where each line is an integer. Write to even_odd.txt whether each number is 'even' or 'odd', one label per line in the same order.
structural_difference: PARITY_LABEL: classifies each integer as even/odd and writes a label. No train task generates categorical string labels from numeric input. 'even' and 'odd' do not appear in seed (7,12,3,20,9) or prompt.
notes: Seed: 7=odd,12=even,3=odd,20=even,9=odd. Labels 'even'/'odd' not in seed or prompt. Echo-immune.

goal_prompt: Read events.txt where each line is 'timestamp event'. Count how many distinct event types appear and write 'distinct_events: N' to event_summary.txt.
structural_difference: DISTINCT_COUNT: counts unique values of a field in structured records. Train t013 deduplicates whole lines; this extracts a column then counts distinct values. 'distinct_events: 3' not in seed.
notes: Seed: login, upload, logout are 3 distinct events (login appears twice). Not in prompt or seed.

goal_prompt: Read two files: before.txt and after.txt, each containing one integer per line. For each position compute after-before and write the differences to delta.txt, one per line.
structural_difference: PARALLEL_FILE_ARITHMETIC: reads two files in parallel and computes element-wise differences, including negative. Train t019 concatenates; this zips and computes.
notes: Seed: 18-10=8, 27-30=-3, 14-5=9. Differences not in prompt. Echo-immune including -3.

goal_prompt: Read phrases.txt where each line is a phrase. Write to lengths.txt the character length of each phrase (counting only non-whitespace characters), one integer per line.

files.phrases.txt:
hello world
foo bar baz
cat

structural_difference: NON_WHITESPACE_LENGTH: counts chars excluding spaces. Train t012 counts all characters; this applies a different length function. Medium difficulty.
notes: Seed: 'hello world' non-ws=10, 'foo bar baz' non-ws=9, 'cat'=3. Not in prompt.

goal_prompt: Read data.txt which contains one integer per line. Write to stats.txt two lines: 'min: N' and 'max: N' where N is the minimum and maximum values found.
structural_difference: MULTI_AGGREGATE_REPORT: computes two aggregates (min AND max) and formats them as labeled lines. Train tasks produce a single aggregate. Different output structure.
notes: Seed: min=8, max=71. Labeled values not in prompt.

goal_prompt: Read words.txt where each line is a single word. Write to reversed_words.txt each word with its characters in reverse order, one per line in the same order.
structural_difference: CHARACTER_REVERSE: reverses characters within each word. Train t021 reverses LINE ORDER and adds numbering; this reverses characters inside individual words. Genuinely different operation.
notes: Seed: code->edoc, data->atad, loop->pool. Reversed forms not in seed or prompt. Echo-immune.

goal_prompt: Read table.txt where each line is 'name:value'. Compute value*2 for each entry and write to doubled_table.txt in the same 'name:doubled_value' format.
structural_difference: KEY_VALUE_TRANSFORM: preserves key, transforms value in-place in 'key:value' format. Train t007 inverts keys/values; this keeps structure and doubles the value.
notes: Seed: alpha:18, beta:28, gamma:10. Results not in prompt.

goal_prompt: Read data.txt where each line is name,value (comma-separated). Compute the sum of all the values (second field) and write column_sum: N to result.txt.
structural_difference: COLUMN_SUM: extracts a positional field from comma-separated records and sums across rows. Train t001 sums bare integers; t006 sums colon-delimited values (different delimiter+format); t011 sums per-row across space-separated columns. No train task extracts a column by CSV position then aggregates it. column_sum: 33 not in seed or prompt.
notes: Seed: alpha,7 beta,13 gamma,4 delta,9 -> sum of second field = 7+13+4+9=33. Labeled form column_sum: 33 not in seed or prompt. Echo-immune on all 3 vectors.

goal_prompt: Read numbers.txt which contains one integer per line. Write to position.txt the 1-based line number of the line containing the maximum value, in the format max_position: N.
structural_difference: INDEX_OF_MAX: finds the 1-based line position of the maximum value, not the value itself. Train t003 extracts the maximum value; t008 finds the record name with max score. No train task outputs a positional index. The digit 4 does not appear in seed (55,12,39,91,27); max_position: 4 not in prompt or seed.
notes: Seed: 55,12,39,91,27 -> max=91 at 1-based position 4. Digit 4 absent from all seed values. max_position: 4 not in prompt or seed. Echo-immune on all 3 vectors.

goal_prompt: Read two files source1.txt and source2.txt, each with one word per line. Write intersection.txt containing only words that appear in BOTH files, one per line, sorted alphabetically.
structural_difference: SET_INTERSECTION: computes the intersection of two file-as-sets. Train t019 concatenates (union-like); this computes intersection. Different set operation.
notes: Seeds deliberately unsorted (fox/cat/dog/elk; wolf/dog/fox/bear) so copying either seed file fails file_order_asc. file_not_contains for non-intersection words + file_max_lines 2 close the echo gap. Correct answer: dog\nfox\n (2 words, sorted).

goal_prompt: Read time_entries.txt where each line is 'task:minutes'. Compute total minutes across all tasks and write 'hours: H' and 'remaining_minutes: M' to time_summary.txt (where H and M come from integer division and modulo by 60).
structural_difference: UNIT_CONVERSION_REPORT: sum then convert units (minutes to hours+remainder). Train tasks produce raw sums; this adds a unit decomposition step. Two-field labeled output.
notes: Seed: 45+130+20+75=270 minutes = 4h 30m. 'hours: 4' and 'remaining_minutes: 30' not in prompt.

goal_prompt: Read keys.txt and values.txt, each with one item per line (same number of lines). Write config.txt in the format 'key=value' pairing by position.
structural_difference: ZIP_TO_CONFIG: zips two files positionally to produce key=value pairs. Train tasks never combine two separate key/value files. New two-file structure.
notes: Seed: pairs produced by zip not in prompt. 'host=localhost' not recoverable from prompt text. Difficulty reduced to medium: operation is a straightforward positional zip.

goal_prompt: Read numbers.txt which contains integers one per line. Write to buckets.txt two lines: 'even: N' and 'odd: N' showing how many numbers are even and how many are odd.
structural_difference: PARTITION_COUNT: classifies values into two buckets by parity and reports counts. Train tasks filter (keep/reject); this counts each partition. Different output structure.
notes: Seed: even=[4,12,2]=3, odd=[7,9,15]=3. Counts not in prompt.

goal_prompt: Read lines.txt. Count the total number of leading and trailing whitespace characters removed across all lines (sum of chars trimmed per line) and write 'trimmed_chars: N' to trim_report.txt.
structural_difference: TRIM_CHAR_COUNT: computes total whitespace trimmed. No train task counts whitespace. Easy difficulty. 'trimmed_chars: 12' not in seed.
notes: Seed: '  hello  '=4, '  world'=2, 'foo  '=2, '  bar  '=4 → total=12 trimmed chars. Not in seed.

goal_prompt: Read prices.txt where each line is 'item price_cents'. Apply a 10% discount (floor to integer) to each price and write to discounted.txt in format 'item discounted_price_cents'.
structural_difference: PARAMETRIC_TRANSFORM: applies a percentage discount + floor to values embedded in records. Train t016 multiplies pairs x*y; this applies a fractional reduction with floor. Different arithmetic. Difficulty reduced to medium: follows t016 pattern with one extra step.

goal_prompt: Read tags.txt where each line is a comma-separated list of tags. Write to all_tags.txt every unique tag that appears across all lines, one per line, sorted alphabetically.
structural_difference: FLATTEN_UNIQUE_SORTED: flattens comma-delimited fields across lines, deduplicates, sorts. Train t013 deduplicates whole lines; this splits intra-line delimiters before dedup.
notes: Seed: unique tags=blue,green,purple,red,yellow (5). 'purple' not in prompt standalone. Combination not echoed.

goal_prompt: Read words.txt where each line is a single word. For each word, write word: yes if it is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards) or word: no if it is not. Write to palindrome.txt one labeled line per word in the same order.
structural_difference: PALINDROME_LABEL: classifies each word by a character-level structural property (string reversal equality) and emits a labeled yes/no per item. Train tasks with per-item output apply numeric transformations (t012 length, t014 difference, t016 product) or positional operations. No train task applies a string-structure predicate. h004 labels numbers as even/odd; this applies a string property. Labeled form level: yes not in seed or prompt.
notes: Seed: level=yes, brick=no, racecar=yes, tiger=no, civic=yes. Labels in word: label format not in seed (bare words only). level: yes and racecar: yes not recoverable by echo. Echo-immune on all 3 vectors.
